prompt: In a cinematic film still, the humid air of a vast botanical greenhouse hangs heavy with mist. On the far left stands a tall gardener in green overalls holding a watering can. Beside him, a small child in a yellow raincoat reaches for a fern. A white cat sits on a wooden bench near the center, watching intently. Next to the cat, an elderly woman in a floral dress points at a blooming orchid. To her right, a young man in a blue shirt looks at the flower. In the foreground, a brown leather satchel rests on the tiled floor. A pair of gardening gloves lies next to the satchel. Behind them, a large glass pane reflects the interior. A silver trowel leans against a terracotta pot. The pot contains a vibrant red hibiscus. Above, hanging vines drape from the iron ceiling beams. A black bird perches on one of the vines. Near the back wall, a stone statue of a nymph stands silently. A mossy rock sits at the statue's base. A brass thermometer hangs on a nearby pillar. A coiled green hose lies on the ground near the pillar. A wooden ladder leans against the central support beam. At the top of the ladder, a person in a grey hat adjusts a light fixture. Below the ladder, a tabby dog sniffs the air. A picnic basket sits open on a checkered blanket. A red apple rolls out of the basket. A clear water bottle stands upright next to the apple. The gardener hands the watering can to the child. The elderly woman gestures toward the young man. The white cat stares at the black bird. The tabby dog looks at the picnic basket. The person in the grey hat reaches for the light. The young man stands next to the elderly woman. The brown leather satchel is next to the gardening gloves. The stone statue is behind the mossy rock. There is no digital clock visible on the walls. There is no plastic signage marking the plants. There is no modern electric fan circulating the air.
